name: AfterShip
label: AfterShip Tracking API 2026-07
description: AfterShip Tracking 2026-07. Header as-api-key. Create body is a tracking envelope in official examples; OfficialApiNode bodyFrom sends top-level fields (tracking_number, slug, …). Buyer PII on tracking pages — do not log. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (trigger) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event). Docs: https://www.aftership.com/docs/tracking/quickstart/api-quick-start Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One official API operation. Secrets stay in configurationParameters.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Official API verb. EXACT: tracking_create | tracking_get | tracking_update | courier_detect | trigger. Blank uses configurationParameters.operation. trigger (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port).

schema.label: id
schema.description: Resource id for get/update/delete path {id} when that operation needs it.

schema.label: tracking_number
schema.description: Carrier tracking number for tracking_create and courier_detect. Alphanumeric. Example: 9400111899562537831249.

schema.label: slug
schema.description: Courier slug for tracking_create (aftership courier list). Example: ups.

schema.label: slug_group
schema.description: Courier slug group for tracking_create when slug is unknown. Example: amazon-group.

schema.label: title
schema.description: Human title for tracking_create. Example: Ada's charger.

schema.label: order_id
schema.description: Merchant order id stored on the tracking (tracking_create). Example: ORD-42.

ports.name: output
ports.description: status=ok + data on 2xx. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Secrets never present. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status. Never includes secrets.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. May contain order PII — do not log values.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb for OfficialApiNode. EXACT: tracking_create | tracking_get | tracking_update | courier_detect | trigger. Selecting trigger (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: StudioQuack secret. Auth type header. Never log. Customer owns the merchant account.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout seconds (connect + read). <=0 uses api_spec defaultTimeout.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
